scripts.build: (node -e "process.exit(process.env.TURBO_HASH ? 0 : 1)" || pnpm -w all //#gen) && pnpm --dir ../../vendor/eliza --filter @elizaos/cloud run build:worker && vibelang -p tsconfig.json
scripts.bundle: pnpm build && VITE_GRACE_CLOUD_API_ORIGIN=https://api-staging.graceforseniors.com VITE_GRACE_CLOUD_WEB_ORIGIN=https://app-staging.graceforseniors.com pnpm --filter @repo/app build && wrangler deploy --env staging --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/bundle/staging && pnpm --filter @repo/app build && wrangler deploy --env production --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/bundle/production
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @repo/app test:browser test/browser.browser.test.tsx -t 'Browse and return to the page I left' && pnpm --filter @repo/app build && wrangler deploy --env production
